title: Icon Library Editor project (.ile)
description: An icon project for the Icon Library editor (https://iconlibrary.io). Open it with the editor's "Open .ile" button or with a link: https://iconlibrary.io/#ile=<base64url or URL-encoded JSON>. See https://iconlibrary.io/llms.txt.

versao.description: Format version. Files with a higher version are refused.

nome.description: Project name, shown in the editor and used as the file name.

editavel.description: true shows "Open in Lucide Studio" (only for single-style 24×24 stroke icons).

raiz.description: Attributes of the <svg> tag. Lucide style: {"xmlns": "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "width": "24", "height": "24", "viewBox": "0 0 24 24", "fill": "none", "stroke": "currentColor", "stroke-width": "2", "stroke-linecap": "round", "stroke-linejoin": "round"}.

grupos.description: One entry per icon when several icons are layered. Optional: without it, every shape belongs to one icon.

elementos.description: The shapes, drawn in order (later ones on top).

oneOf.description: A shape the editor can draw and reshape.

attrs.description: SVG attributes as strings, e.g. {"d": "M12 2v20"} or {"cx": "12", "cy": "12", "r": "4"}. Own fill/stroke/stroke-width override the <svg> ones.

oneOf.description: Any other element (g, text…), kept as markup and editable only in the code. Scripts, event attributes, javascript: links and foreignObject are removed on opening.

grupo.description: Index in "grupos" of the icon this shape belongs to. Default 0.

oculto.description: Hidden shapes stay in the project but are left out of the SVG. Default false.
